Person.title: Person
Person.description: Represents one of the four core users in the FamiliaFlow application, with customizable display name and a distinct color theme.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Person entity. Fixed IDs (e.g., 'person1', 'person2', 'person3', 'person4') are used.

name.description: The display name for the person, configurable by the user.

color.description: A hexadecimal color code (e.g., '#RRGGBB') assigned to the person for visual distinction in the calendar.

Memo.title: Memo
Memo.description: A personal note or memo belonging to a specific family member.

personId.description: The ID of the person this memo belongs to.

FixedEventTemplate.title: FixedEventTemplate
FixedEventTemplate.description: A reusable template for frequently scheduled events, allowing users to quickly add pre-defined events to the calendar.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FixedEventTemplate entity.

name.description: The name of the event template, displayed in the templates library.

defaultDurationMinutes.description: The default duration for an event created from this template, in minutes. Must be a multiple of 30.

defaultTime.description: An optional default time of day (HH:MM) for events created from this template.

defaultAssigneePersonId.description: Optional reference to the Person ID who is typically assigned this event. (Relationship: Person 1:N FixedEventTemplate)

notes.description: Optional detailed notes or description for events created from this template.

categoryColor.description: Optional hexadecimal color code for events created from this template, or an identifier for a visual category.

CalendarEventSeries.title: CalendarEventSeries
CalendarEventSeries.description: Represents a single event or a series of recurring events on the calendar, defining its core properties and recurrence rules.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CalendarEventSeries entity.

personId.description: Reference to the Person ID to whom this event series is assigned. (Relationship: Person 1:N CalendarEventSeries)

title.description: The main title or name of the event series.

notes.description: Optional detailed notes or description for the event series.

templateId.description: Optional reference to the FixedEventTemplate ID from which this series was created. (Relationship: FixedEventTemplate 1:N CalendarEventSeries)

startTime.description: The standard start time of day (HH:MM) for occurrences within this series. Must be in 30-minute increments.

endTime.description: The standard end time of day (HH:MM) for occurrences within this series. Must be in 30-minute increments.

startDate.description: The effective start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the recurrence of this series.

frequency.description: The recurrence frequency of the event series. 'NONE' for single events.

interval.description: The interval for recurrence (e.g., 'every 2 days' means interval=2). Default is 1.

byWeekday.description: An array of 2-letter weekday codes (e.g., 'MO', 'TU') for WEEKLY recurrence. (Relationship: CalendarEventSeries N:N Weekday)

byMonthDay.description: The day of the month (1-31) for MONTHLY recurrence.

untilDate.description: The end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a recurring series with an 'End on date' condition.

count.description: The number of occurrences for a recurring series with an 'End after X occurrences' condition.

exceptions.description: An array of specific dates (YYYY-MM-DD) on which occurrences of this series are explicitly excluded.

EventOccurrenceOverride.title: EventOccurrenceOverride
EventOccurrenceOverride.description: Stores specific overrides or state changes (like completion) for individual occurrences of a CalendarEventSeries, diverging from the series' default properties.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EventOccurrenceOverride entity.

seriesId.description: Reference to the CalendarEventSeries ID this override applies to. (Relationship: CalendarEventSeries 1:N EventOccurrenceOverride)

occurrenceDate.description: The specific date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the occurrence to which this override applies.

completed.description: Boolean flag indicating if this specific event occurrence has been marked as completed.

completedAt.description: Optional timestamp (ISO 8601) when the occurrence was marked as completed.

personIdOverride.description: Optional override for the Person ID assigned to this specific occurrence, if different from the series default. (Relationship: Person 1:N EventOccurrenceOverride)

titleOverride.description: Optional override for the title of this specific occurrence.

notesOverride.description: Optional override for the notes of this specific occurrence.

startTimeOverride.description: Optional override for the start time (HH:MM) of this specific occurrence. Must be in 30-minute increments.

endTimeOverride.description: Optional override for the end time (HH:MM) of this specific occurrence. Must be in 30-minute increments.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Stores application-wide configuration settings, including calendar display preferences and selected localization options.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppSettings entity. This entity is typically a singleton (e.g., 'global-settings').

dayStartTime.description: The configurable start time (HH:MM) for the calendar day view. Default is 05:00.

dayEndTime.description: The configurable end time (HH:MM) for the calendar day view. Default is 22:00.

language.description: The currently selected application language. 'en' for English, 'ar' for Arabic.

params.name: settingsId
params.description: The unique ID for the AppSettings document.
